description: OMENZ FX Rates: convert an amount between ~30 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, MXN, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, INR, BRL...) at the European Central Bank's official reference rate, today or any business day in the last 90 days (weekends/holidays use the previous business day, said so). Returns result, rate, inverse rate and the rate date. Deterministic and auditable for invoices, pricing and bookkeeping; not a live trading quote. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/fx/convert, $0.002 via x402.)
name: fx_convert
